name: Domaine de Marie
kicker: Pink convent church on Ngo Quyen
summary: Domaine de Marie is the pink church and convent garden at 1 Ngo Quyen, on the west ridge. Visit Lâm Đồng lists entry as free. Allow 20 to 30 minutes. It is not the rooster cathedral on Tran Phu. Hours are Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The courtyard at Domaine de Marie

notice.title: Not the Chicken Church
notice.body: The rooster tower is Da Lat Cathedral on Tran Phu. Domaine de Marie is the convent church at 1 Ngo Quyen.

body: The pink church and the convent garden are at 1 Ngo Quyen. Vietnam Tourism names Domaine de Marie among the hill-station stops. Twenty to thirty minutes covers the front and the garden.
Entry is free on Visit Lâm Đồng. Hours are Check on arrival. Do not call this the Chicken Church. That rooster is on the cathedral tower on Tran Phu, a different address.

gettingThere: The church is at 1 Ngo Quyen, on the west ridge. Take a taxi from Xuan Huong Lake. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.
